messages:
maya: Hey team, running the Go quickstart sample and I get a 403 with body {"error":"billing_required"}. I'm the workspace owner though?

kevin: Did you create the key under Workspace > API keys or Account > API keys? Workspace keys get blocked if billing isn't set up.

maya: I used the key generated from the workspace, yes. Thought invites auto-provision a trial. No billing emails in spam.

billing-bot: workspace acme-infra status: TRIAL_EXPIRED -> billing_required. Hosted API calls from workspace keys are disabled. Visit https://app.redwood.ai/workspace/acme-infra/billing to add a payment method.

maya: ok that explains it. Odd thing: curl with same key returned 401 earlier this morning and now Go client returns 403. Inconsistent.

sdk-bot: SDK telemetry: recorded error.kind=auth and error.subcode=billing_required in go-sdk v0.4.2. We should normalize to one status code. Filing sdk ticket.

kevin: For immediate unblock, create a personal key (Account -> API keys) and use that for local dev, or add billing.

maya: personal key worked. First successful call logged :)

ops: Note for docs: add a one-liner in quickstart "If you were invited to a workspace, workspace API keys may be restricted until billing is configured; use a personal key for initial testing." Also add troubleshooting FAQ about 401 vs 403.

kevin: I'll pick up SDK change to return 402 consistently for billing blocks and include error.documentation_url pointing to the workspace billing page. We'll also add a clearer message string.

maya: also found a UX quirk: invite flow doesn't show "Set up billing" until you go to workspace settings. Might fail discoverability.

billing-bot: created ticket BILL-129: Surface billing requirement on invite acceptance flow.

maya: resolving my issue, thanks. Leaving here in case others hit it.
